LanguageData.PS_SetOverrideNote: {0} by a tiering override from {1}. This setting does nothing right now.
LanguageData.PS_Ovr_MedAwaken: Awakening from meditation is switched off
LanguageData.PS_Ovr_ExtPsylink: Awakening from an outside psylink is switched off
LanguageData.PS_Ovr_PsylinkGate: The psylink check is switched off
LanguageData.PS_Ovr_RandomSpawns: Random awakened pawns are switched off
LanguageData.PS_Ovr_Transcend: Tiers past Illuminated are switched off
LanguageData.PS_Ovr_EnemyTiers: Tiers on enemy psycasters are switched off
LanguageData.PS_SetPerLevel: Each level makes a psycast {0}% stronger
LanguageData.PS_SetPerLevelTip: Raises its damage, the size of its area and how long its effect lasts.
LanguageData.PS_SetMaxSkillLevel: Highest level one psycast can reach: {0}
LanguageData.PS_SetMaxSkillLevelTip: The Convergence specialization adds five more on top of this.
LanguageData.PS_SetPsyLevelsPerSkill: Psycaster levels needed for each psycast level: {0}
LanguageData.PS_SetPsyLevelsPerSkillTip: Stops you pouring every point into one psycast early on. At 3, a level 30 psycaster can take a single psycast to level 10.
LanguageData.PS_SetAutoStats: Psycaster stats go up on their own
LanguageData.PS_SetAutoStatsTip: Neural heat, heat recovery and psychic sensitivity rise with every psycaster level, so your points stay free for psycasts. Turn this off to get the "Upgrade Psycaster Stats" button back.
LanguageData.PS_SetLinksTip: Psycasts in the same tree are linked. Levelling one adds a little to the ones it feeds, and the skill card shows you which.
LanguageData.PS_SetSynergyPctTip: How much one level of a linked psycast gives to the psycast it feeds.
LanguageData.PS_SetScalePowerTip: Melee hits, explosions and anything else measured as raw power.
LanguageData.PS_SetScaleRadiusTip: How far an area effect reaches.
LanguageData.PS_SetScaleDurationTip: Buffs, debuffs and anything else with a timer on it.
LanguageData.PS_SetScaleBuffTip: How hard the effect lands, not just how long it stays.
LanguageData.PS_SetScaleSensTip: Some add-on psycasts work out their size from the caster's sensitivity. This lifts it for the moment of the cast so those grow too.
LanguageData.PS_SetScaleCostTip: Higher levels use more psyfocus and build more neural heat. Only a psycast's own levels add cost. Links are always free.
LanguageData.PS_SetCostPerLevelTip: How fast the cost climbs as you level a psycast.
LanguageData.PS_SetLockPaths: New trees come only from awakening cards
LanguageData.PS_SetLockPathsTip: The Unlock buttons in the psycast tab are switched off. A pawn gets a tree when they awaken or climb a tier and pick a card. Dev mode can still unlock anything.
LanguageData.PS_SetNoGeneReqTip: Trees that ask for a gene, such as Archon, can be taken without it.
LanguageData.PS_SetMechTreesTip: Turns on the Mechanitor trees the add-on ships but marks as removed content.
LanguageData.PS_SetAutoPathsTip: These trees are treated as already unlocked for your colonists, prisoners and slaves as soon as they are psycasters.
LanguageData.PS_SetDisableAbilityUnlocks: New Psycasts cannot be unlocked with points
LanguageData.PS_SetDisableAbilityUnlocksTip: Psycast points can still level up psycasts the pawn already knows, but they can no longer be spent to unlock new psycasts from the tree.
LanguageData.PS_SetRestrictUnlockLevel: Cannot unlock a psycast before the pawn has the psycaster level for it
LanguageData.PS_SetRestrictUnlockLevelTip: Uses the same psycaster-level gate as psycast leveling. If a node would start above the pawn's current psycaster level, it stays locked.
LanguageData.PS_SetAllowPsytrainerBypassTip: Allows psytrainers to unlock psycasts regardless of level requirement.
LanguageData.PS_SetSpecLevelsTip: How often levelling up hands you a point for the constellation. Lower means points arrive faster.
LanguageData.PS_SetSpecXpTip: Casting earns points as well. Lower opens the Apotheosis tree sooner.
LanguageData.PS_SetTier2PointsTip: Handed over the moment a pawn becomes Enlightened.
LanguageData.PS_SetTier3PointsTip: Handed over the moment a pawn becomes Illuminated.
LanguageData.PS_SetCastXp: Casting XP per psycast tier: {0} (a tier 3 cast gives {1})
LanguageData.PS_SetCastXpTip: Casting is the main way to level up. Deeper psycasts are worth more per cast.
LanguageData.PS_SetMedXp: Meditation XP: {0}% of the normal rate
LanguageData.PS_SetMedXpTip: Meditation trickles in levels too, in the background.
LanguageData.PS_SetNoDecay: Psyfocus never drains on its own
LanguageData.PS_SetNoDecayTip: On, psyfocus only drops when you cast. Off, it slowly bleeds away like vanilla and has to be topped up.
LanguageData.PS_SetBreakthroughsTip: A meditating pawn can be struck by a flow of old knowledge. A psycaster gains a level; anyone else moves closer to awakening.
LanguageData.PS_SetBreakChanceTip: Rolled once an hour for a meditating psycaster who has not yet reached Illuminated. Meditating for hours without a break pushes it higher. Set it to 0 and they never break through at all.
LanguageData.PS_SetBreakChanceTrans: Breakthrough chance each hour past Illuminated: {0}%
LanguageData.PS_SetBreakChanceTransTip: The same roll once a psycaster has climbed past Illuminated. Set it apart from the one above to make late game breakthroughs rarer or more common than the climb to get there. 0 stops them completely.
LanguageData.PS_SetFalloff: Falloff from meditating too much: x{0}
LanguageData.PS_SetFalloffTip: Meditating past the safe window makes breakthroughs rarer, so a pawn cannot sit and farm them. 0 turns the falloff off.
LanguageData.PS_SetGuarantee: Awakening is certain after {0} hours of meditation
LanguageData.PS_SetGuaranteeTip: A pawn who is not yet a psycaster gets better odds the longer they meditate, and awakens for sure at this total. 36 is about a week of six hour days.
LanguageData.PS_SetPilgrimPity: Pilgrimage offered after {0} hours of meditation
LanguageData.PS_SetPilgrimPityTip: An awakened pawn is offered a tier-up journey once their meditation reaches this total. The climb to Tier III takes half as long again. 0 leaves it entirely to the storyteller.
LanguageData.PS_SetTransCurveTip: On top of the chance above, each tier past Illuminated makes breakthroughs more likely again, so free levels keep coming as levelling slows down. The chance never passes 60%.
LanguageData.PS_SetSafeWindowOff: Safe meditation: all day, meditating is never risky
LanguageData.PS_SetSafeWindowTip: Up to this much a day carries no risk. Past it, every hour can drop the pawn into a psychic coma, and each coma after that lasts longer, up to eight days. Meditation during a pilgrimage is always safe. Drag this all the way to 24 hours to switch comas off completely and let your pawns meditate as much as they like.
LanguageData.PS_SetComaRisk: Coma risk for each extra hour: {0}%
LanguageData.PS_SetComaRiskTip: Rolled once an hour, so the ninth hour of a day is about three times as risky as the seventh. A coma lasts from four hours up to eight days.
LanguageData.PS_SetEnableAwakeningTreeChoiceTip: Upon Awakening or Tier increase, the pawn is offered a choice of psycasting trees to unlock.
LanguageData.PS_SetRevealAll: Turn the cards one at a time
LanguageData.PS_SetRevealAllTip: The rest of the deal stays face down and you turn each card by hand. Any card you have turned can still be the one you take. Off, the card you turn is the one you get.
LanguageData.PS_SetCardCountTip: How many face-down cards a tier-up deals. The deal is never bigger than the number of trees the pawn is still missing.
LanguageData.PS_SetCardRedeal: Allow one reroll at a first awakening
LanguageData.PS_SetCardRedealTip: Puts a Reroll button in the top right of the card window once you have turned a card, so a pawn's first awakening is not settled by one bad hand. One per awakening. Tier II and Tier III keep their own reroll, which costs another round of meditation.
LanguageData.PS_SetChooseLaterInfo: You can always press "Choose later". The cards come back while the colonist meditates, and the alert reopens them with one click.
LanguageData.PS_SetEmpirePsylink: A psylink from anywhere else counts as awakening
LanguageData.PS_SetEmpirePsylinkTip: Empire ceremonies, the blinding ritual and anima linking bring the pawn into this mod and deal them a card, instead of leaving them a psycaster with no tree.
LanguageData.PS_SetPsylinkGate: Take psylinks off pawns who never awakened
LanguageData.PS_SetPsylinkGateTip: A pawn generated already holding a psylink loses it unless they also have a tier, so psycasters are earned rather than handed out. Pilgrimage enemies are exempt.
LanguageData.PS_SetSpawnChance: Chance any pawn arrives as a psycaster: {0}%
LanguageData.PS_SetSpawnChanceTip: Every eligible pawn aged 13 or over, in any faction, gets this chance to arrive as a proper awakened psycaster with a psylink, a tree and a tier. 0% means none.
LanguageData.PS_SetNoStartAwakened: Your starting colonists never arrive awakened
LanguageData.PS_SetNoStartAwakenedTip: Everyone you begin with has an ordinary mind and has to earn their awakening.
LanguageData.PS_SetTranscendTip: An Illuminated pawn who keeps meditating climbs into Transcendent tiers. Each one gives bonus specialization points and a free card. Off, Illuminated is the ceiling.
LanguageData.PS_SetTransBaseTip: Hours of meditation after Illuminated needed to reach Tier IV.
LanguageData.PS_SetTransGrowth: Each tier costs x{0} the one before
LanguageData.PS_SetTransGrowthTip: At 1.6, Tier V costs 1.6 times Tier IV and Tier VI costs 2.56 times.
LanguageData.PS_SetForgoPoints: Points for turning the card down: {0}
LanguageData.PS_SetForgoPointsTip: At a Transcendent tier-up you can take these points instead of a free tree, on top of the tier's own 3.
LanguageData.PS_SetH_Altar: Trial of the Altar (one site, enemies attack)
LanguageData.PS_SetAltarTotal: Meditation needed: {0} hours (about {1} days at the daily limit)
LanguageData.PS_SetAltarTotalTip: How long the pilgrim has to sit at the altar before the tier is earned.
LanguageData.PS_SetAltarDaily: Daily limit: {0} hours a day (0 for no limit)
LanguageData.PS_SetAltarDailyTip: Spreads the journey over real time. Meditation on a pilgrimage never causes a coma, so a bigger limit simply finishes it sooner.
LanguageData.PS_SetWaveIntervalTip: How often the Ancient Psycaster Order comes for the altar. Only this journey has attacks.
LanguageData.PS_SetH_AltarFocus: What the pilgrim meditates at (Tier II)
LanguageData.PS_SetT3Throne: Tier III always uses the grand throne.
LanguageData.PS_SetFocus_PilgrimThrone: Meditation throne (default, stands in a reliquary)
LanguageData.PS_SetFocus_GrandThrone: Vanilla grand throne (needs a royal title)
LanguageData.PS_SetH_Anima: Way of the Anima (several sites, no fighting)
LanguageData.PS_SetAnimaPerSiteTip: Nothing attacks on this journey, and meditation on a pilgrimage never causes a coma.
LanguageData.PS_SetAnimaT2Tip: How many anima trees the Tier II journey visits.
LanguageData.PS_SetAnimaT3Tip: How many the Tier III journey visits. The last one grows the giant ancient anima tree.
LanguageData.PS_SetEnemyTiersTip: Mostly the Empire. They arrive with a stronger psylink, more trees and abilities, full psyfocus and faster casting.
LanguageData.PS_SetEnemyT2Tip: A real threat to an early colony.
LanguageData.PS_SetEnemyT3Tip: The strongest hostile psycasters in the mod.
LanguageData.PS_SetEnemyFreq: How many of them get a tier: {0}%
LanguageData.PS_SetEnemyFreqTip: Rolled for each hostile psycaster as they are generated.
LanguageData.PS_SetEnemyAscension: Tier III can carry a full Apotheosis tree
LanguageData.PS_SetEnemyAscensionTip: Gives the best enemy psycasters a whole constellation's worth of power. A late game problem, and off by default.
LanguageData.PS_SetFogOfWar: Hide psycasts you have not learned
LanguageData.PS_SetFogOfWarTip: An unlearned psycast shows a question mark instead of its icon, so you find out what each one is when you take it. The shape of the tree still shows.
LanguageData.PS_SetFogNext: Still show the ones you can pick next
LanguageData.PS_SetFogNextTip: Psycasts you already meet the requirements for stay visible, so your next choice is always in front of you. Only what sits deeper up the tree is hidden.
LanguageData.PS_SetHidePaths: Hide trees this pawn has not unlocked
LanguageData.PS_SetHidePathsTip: The tree list shows only what the pawn owns instead of a wall of dark tiles. Works while new trees come from awakening cards, and dev mode still shows everything.
LanguageData.PS_SetSkillFxTip: Sparks and a soft sound when you spend a point, and a gold flare when a psycast reaches its top level.
LanguageData.PS_SetMedBars: Meditation bars in the psycast tab
LanguageData.PS_SetMedBarsTip: Small bars for coma risk, progress to the next psycaster level, and the climb to the next tier.
LanguageData.PS_SetNoSkillResetTip: Removes the "Reset skills" button from the psycast tab. Points you spend are spent for good.
LanguageData.PS_SetNoSpecResetTip: Removes the refund button from the constellation window.
LanguageData.PS_SetPerfCacheTip: Keeps the mod cheap to run, and numbers still update the instant anything changes. Leave this on. Turn it off only if a number on screen looks wrong and you want to rule this out.
LanguageData.PS_SetLevelCap: Set the psycaster level cap here
LanguageData.PS_SetLevelCapTip: Overrides Vanilla Psycasts Expanded's own cap with the number below. Tiers do not raise or lower it. Off leaves VPE's setting alone.
LanguageData.PS_SetIsekai: Stop ISEKAI RPG raising psycaster stats
LanguageData.PS_SetIsekaiTip: Keeps this mod in charge of psychic sensitivity, neural heat, recovery and psyfocus when ISEKAI RPG Leveling is installed. Takes effect after a restart.
LanguageData.PS_SetSynDisabledNote: Links are switched off on the Psycast levels page. You can still edit them here, but nothing happens in game until you turn them back on.
LanguageData.PS_SetSynFrozen: Links are worked out once, the first time you play, and then stay put. Adding psycast add-ons later never reshuffles them.
LanguageData.PS_SetSynRetune: To change what a psycast does and what it feeds, turn on dev mode and open the balance editor from the psycast tab.
LanguageData.PS_SetSynEditsActive: You have {0} of your own edits in place.
LanguageData.PS_SetSynRebuild: Work the links out again from the psycasts you have installed
LanguageData.PS_MsgSynRebuilt: Links worked out again from the psycasts you have installed.
LanguageData.PS_SetBalanceInfo: Anything you change in the balance editor is kept here and applied on top of the mod's own numbers. The mod is in open beta: if you have balancing ideas, tune them in the editor and press Share to write them out as a file, sorted by tree, then send that file to the author.
LanguageData.PS_SetShare: Share my balance edits (write a file)
LanguageData.PS_SetShareN: Share my {0} balance edits (write a file)
LanguageData.PS_MsgNoShare: You have not changed anything yet. Tune some numbers in the balance editor first.
LanguageData.PS_SetImport: Load balance edits from a file
LanguageData.PS_SetImportBody: Loaded {0} balance edits from {1}. They sit on top of the mod's own numbers and can be shared, thrown away, or baked in dev mode like any others.
LanguageData.PS_MsgNoImportFiles: No balance files found. Drop one someone shared with you into: {0}
LanguageData.PS_SetBake: Bake my edits in as the mod's defaults
LanguageData.PS_SetBakeN: Bake my {0} edits in as the mod's defaults
LanguageData.PS_SetBakeBody: Write your {0} edits into ManualBalance.json as the mod's new defaults and clear your own list? A Workshop update can overwrite that file, so bake again afterwards if it does.
LanguageData.PS_SetDiscardBody: Throw away all {0} of your balance edits and go back to the mod's own numbers?
